meta.title: Starship Meridian
meta.notes: One paid generation, extended twice from the same first half, the second extension kept. meridian-1-t1 (8 s, from ch-meridian-1) was continued by the provider with ch-meridian-2 (8 s), which returns the source clip and its new tail as one 16 s file; take 1 of that (meridian-full-t1) put a badge on the captain, so it was run again as meridian-full-t2, which is byte-identical to review/clips/ch-meridian.mp4. Nothing was laid over it. Its first 191 frames match meridian-1-t1 and the Vorrek starts on frame 191 (7.958 s). The segments are the take's own shots, in step, cut where the picture cuts (frame/24), down to the take's own cut to black on frame 371 (15.458 s; the review note says 15.7). All the sound is the take's own: the lines and the klaxon. The klaxon is in the take's own sound, so it is a sound-effect item that labels it, from the red alert through the cut to black.

segments.label: The viewscreen: the spiky green warship
The bridge: the captain rises and tugs his tunic down
The viewscreen: the fin-crested Vorrek sneers
Red alert: the klaxon, the bridge floods red
Hard cut to black in the middle of the alarm

lines.speaker: Captain Halloran
lines.text: This is Captain Halloran of the starship Meridian. You have crossed into protected space.

lines.speaker: Vorrek commander
lines.text: Your borders mean nothing to the Vorrek.

sfx.label: The red-alert klaxon, in the take's own sound
